mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_days (trip_id, day_number, trip_date, title, memo) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{dayNumber}, #{tripDate}, #{title}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM trip_days WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY day_number
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_days SET day_number = day_number + 100, trip_date = trip_date + 1000 WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}
